meta.parties: Punchi Banda (Executor of the Last Will of Bandara Menika) v. Yusubu Lebbe

rules.statement: 'Probate jurisdiction' does not mean the same thing as 'testamentary jurisdiction', and a decree for judicial settlement is not made in the exercise of probate jurisdiction.
rules.supporting_quote: "' Probate jurisdiction ' does not mean the same thing as our term ' testamentary jurisdiction, ' which includes the control of the administration of the estates of deceased persons by executors October 12. and administrators. It must be limited to that power of the Court by which it grants or refuses probate of a testamentary paper, and thereby conclusively authenticates the paper as containing the last will of the deceased."
